FIELDS.NAME: Petals & Posies Florist
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Petals & Posies Florist operates as a retail establishment specializing in the design and delivery of fresh floral arrangements and gifts. Our core operations involve sourcing high-quality flowers and plants from reputable suppliers, which we then craft into customized arrangements for various occasions such as weddings, funerals, and corporate events. We pride ourselves on providing exceptional customer service, maintaining a strong focus on customer satisfaction metrics to ensure repeat business and positive feedback. 

All floral arrangements are created on-site in our brick-and-mortar location, following stringent safety protocols for both in-store operations and delivery. We implement secure packaging and detailed route planning for all deliveries, minimizing the risk of product loss or damage during transit. To enhance our event services, we conduct assessments for all offsite setups.

Our team is trained in proper handling of flowers and health and safety practices, and we have formal commercial contracts in place for all business operations, ensuring that all our activities meet legal standards. Regular risk assessments help us maintain operational integrity and provide a consistent and reliable service to our valued customers.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 06/15/2023, we experienced a loss due to severe weather resulting in the damage of floral inventory estimated at $1,500. The claim was filed and is currently under review with our insurance provider. Additionally, on 09/20/2023, a delivery van encountered a minor accident causing $1,000 in damages to the vehicle, which has been resolved through internal resources.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM, Saturday: 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM, Closed on Sunday
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Medium-Duty Safe, Class B, Secured Storage for Cash and Valuables
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Fencing and security cameras installed around the premises to enhance safety and deter theft.

FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Petals & Posies Florist does not engage in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products; our operations focus solely on the design and delivery of floral arrangements.

FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Petals & Posies Florist does not have any specific catastrophe exposure related to its operations, as the business focuses on floral arrangements and complies with all safety regulations.
